images.subject: A fusion power plant built around one colossal upright ring-shaped tokamak containment torus.
images.detail: Blue-white plasma glows brightly through wide windows along the ring.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.

images.subject: A fusion power plant built around one colossal upright ring-shaped tokamak containment torus.
images.detail: Blue-white plasma glows brightly through wide windows along the ring.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering scorched dark basalt cliff with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks, with the ground all around made of baked deep muted oxblood-red earth, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.
